verdict.summary: The generated figure has the correct four-panel structure (3C and 3F CRF panels plus 3C and 3F absolute-difference panels), correct log-contrast axis direction, baseline-elevated starting responses, saturating curves, and absolute-difference panels that grow toward high contrast. However there is a critical labeling/ordering defect: in BOTH the 3C and 3F CRF panels the curve labeled attended (dark gray) lies BELOW the curve labeled ignored/unattended (blue) across the entire contrast range. This contradicts expected attentional facilitation and is internally inconsistent with the positive attended-minus-unattended absolute-difference panels (suggesting swapped legend labels). 3C also shows no clear leftward shift and the 3C-vs-3F high-contrast separation ordering is reversed.
